title: two_workers_shared_counter
summary: Two worker threads each increment a shared counter once under a mutex; the main thread joins both workers. Workers also format a local log tag. The program must be deadlock-free and the counter must stay within 0..2.

domain_types.name: LogTag
domain_types.description: Locally formatted short log tag string produced by each worker; pure sequential formatting logic.

clauses.text: The shared counter must always stay within the range 0 to 2 inclusive.
Each worker thread increments the shared counter exactly once under the mutex.
The main thread must eventually complete after both worker threads finish.
Each worker formats a short local log tag while updating the counter.

requirements.text: The shared counter must always stay within the range 0 to 2 inclusive.
Each worker thread increments the shared counter exactly once under the mutex.
The main thread must eventually complete after both worker threads finish.
Each worker formats a short local log tag while updating the counter.

source_nl: Write a concurrent Rust program where two worker threads each increment a shared counter once under a mutex, and the main thread waits for both to finish. Each worker should also format a short log tag locally while updating the counter. Make sure the program never deadlocks and the counter stays within 0 to 2.
